name: sop-kemenag
description: E-SOP Digital Kemenag Barito Utara - Monorepo (Astro FE + Go Fiber BE)

scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev --path=/sop-kemenag -- npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.dev:prod: infisical run --env=prod --path=/sop-kemenag -- npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/sop-kemenag -- npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:backend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/sop-kemenag -- npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:local: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
